title: Maths
summary: Number sense to calculus, one idea at a time, with the working shown every time.
description: Maths tutoring from times tables to AP Calculus in Harrow Hill and online — qualified teachers, a written plan, and a report every four weeks.
content:
Most maths trouble is one missing step from two years ago. The free assessment finds it, and the first few weeks fill it before we touch this term's homework.

What we cover

  • Number, fractions and times tables for ages 8 to 11
  • Pre-algebra, algebra and geometry
  • Algebra II, trigonometry and precalculus
  • AP Calculus AB and BC, and AP Statistics

How a session runs

Ten minutes on last week's mistakes, thirty on new material, and ten on a short problem set done without help. Every session ends with the tutor writing one line for parents: what clicked, and what is next.

title: English & reading
summary: Reading with understanding, then writing that makes an argument and holds it.
description: Reading, writing and English tutoring for ages 8 to 18 — comprehension, essays and AP Literature, taught by qualified English teachers.
content:
Strong readers become strong writers, so younger students read aloud every session and older ones read the text before they write about it. We mark drafts the way a teacher does: in the margin, with a reason.

What we cover

  • Reading fluency and comprehension
  • Grammar, punctuation and paragraphing
  • Essay structure, evidence and argument
  • AP Language and AP Literature

How a session runs

Every student keeps one notebook with us. It holds their drafts, our marks and their rewrites, so progress is on the page rather than in a spreadsheet.

title: Sciences
summary: Biology, chemistry and physics taught from the idea up, not the formula down.
description: Biology, chemistry and physics tutoring for middle and high school, up to AP level — concepts first, then the exam technique.
content:
Science grades usually drop when the maths arrives. We teach the idea first, then the equation that describes it, then the kind of question the exam will ask.

What we cover

  • Middle school general science
  • Biology, chemistry and physics
  • AP Biology, AP Chemistry and AP Physics 1
  • Lab write-ups and data questions

How a session runs

Short explanation, worked example, then questions in the style of the student's own tests. Groups are capped at three so everyone gets asked.

title: Entrance & test prep
summary: Timed practice, honest scoring and a plan that starts from the first mock.
description: ISEE, SSAT, SAT and ACT preparation with full timed mocks, scored the way the real test is, and a week-by-week plan.
content:
Test prep works when it is honest. Every student sits a full timed mock in week one, and we build the plan from what it shows rather than from a textbook's order.

What we cover

  • ISEE and SSAT for independent school entry
  • SAT and ACT, digital and paper
  • Timing, pacing and guessing strategy
  • A mock every three weeks, scored and reviewed

How a session runs

Half the session reviews the last mock question by question; half teaches the one skill costing the most points. Parents get the score trend after every mock.

title: Study skills
summary: Planning the week, revising properly and walking into the test calm.
description: A six-session study skills course: planning, note-taking, active revision and test-day calm, for students who work hard and still fall short.
content:
Some students do not need more content; they need a better week. This short course fixes how they plan, revise and sit tests, and it pays off in every subject at once.

What we cover

  • A weekly plan they will actually keep
  • Notes that are useful a month later
  • Retrieval practice instead of re-reading
  • Handling nerves in the exam room

How it runs

Six one-to-one sessions over six weeks, with a check-in on the student's real planner each time. Most families pair it with a subject program.
